Role Description The Human Resources Manager will oversee all core HR functions, including recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and employee relations. This full-time, on-site role based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, involves partnering with leadership to align HR strategies with business goals, maintaining compliance with local labor laws, and implementing HR policies and procedures. Daily responsibilities include managing end-to-end hiring processes, coordinating training and development initiatives, resolving workplace issues, and supporting employee engagement and retention programs. The HR Manager will also maintain HR records and systems, track key HR metrics, and contribute to building an inclusive, high-performance culture that supports LPS Brands’ growth.
q: Strong expertise in core HR functions, including recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and employee relations.

Well-developed communication, interpersonal, and conflict-resolution skills, with the ability to build trust across diverse teams.
Demonstrated ability to partner with leadership, support organizational change, and drive employee engagement initiatives.
Strong organizational and time-management skills, with attention to detail and the ability to handle multiple priorities.
Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; HR certifications (e.g., CIPD, SHRM) are an advantage.
Previous experience as an HR Manager or in a senior HR role, preferably in marketing, media, or a fast-paced agency environment.
Fluency in English; knowledge of Arabic or other languages is beneficial.
Commitment to ethical, inclusive, and non-discriminatory HR practices.
